abstract:
BACKGROUND: Treatment of metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) relies on chemotherapy. Although NALIRIFOX (Nal-IRI, oxaliplatin, 5-fluorouracil [5-FU], leucovorin) improves survival, cumulative toxicity may limit duration, and maintenance strategies remain unexplored. Intratumoral microbiota, particularly Gammaproteobacteria expressing cytidine deaminase, may inactivate gemcitabine and contribute to resistance, a process potentially reversible with antibiotics. We aim to assess maintenance 5-FU after NALIRIFOX and microbiota modulation with fluoroquinolones to enhance gemcitabine sensitivity.
METHODS: PANORAMIX is a multicenter, proof-of-concept, non-comparative phase II trial conducted across 18 French centers with two sequential randomizations. After 8 cycles of NALIRIFOX, patients with mPDAC are randomized (2:1) to either maintenance 5-FU or continuation of NALIRIFOX (Step 1). In Step 2, patients are randomized (1:1) to ciprofloxacin or placebo combined with gemcitabine-based chemotherapy (± paclitaxel). A total of 108 and 92 patients will be enrolled in Steps 1 and 2, respectively. Main inclusion criteria include age >18 years, confirmed mPDAC, ECOG performance status 0-1, and adequate organ function. Primary endpoints are 6-month progression-free survival (Step 1) and 6-month overall survival (Step 2). Secondary endpoints include toxicity and quality of life.
CONCLUSIONS: This two-step trial will address key therapeutic questions in mPDAC and support translational research.
key_points_ko: NALIRIFOX 8주기 후 5-FU 유지요법 또는 NALIRIFOX 지속군으로 2:1 무작위 배정하여 6개월 무진행 생존기간(PFS)을 평가합니다.
2차 치료에서 젬시타빈 기반 항암요법에 ciprofloxacin 또는 위약을 1:1로 병용 투여하여 6개월 전체 생존기간(OS)을 평가합니다.
summary_ko: 전이성 췌관선암(mPDAC) 환자를 대상으로 1차 NALIRIFOX 요법 후 독성을 줄이기 위한 유지요법과 2차 치료 시 항생제를 통한 효과 증대를 검증하는 임상 2상 프로토콜입니다. 환자들은 NALIRIFOX 8주기 투여 후 5-FU(플루오로우라실) 유지요법군과 NALIRIFOX 지속군으로 배정됩니다. 질병 진행 후 2차 젬시타빈 치료 단계에서는 종양 내 세균의 약물 비활성화를 억제하기 위해 ciprofloxacin(시프로플록사신) 또는 위약을 병용합니다. 프랑스 18개 기관에서 1단계 108명, 2단계 92명의 환자를 대상으로 진행됩니다.
title: Optimizing first-line NALIRIFOX and exploring the role of the microbiota in second-line pancreatic cancer treatment: the PRODIGE 105-GERCOR 116 PANORAMIX trial
title_ko: 1차 NALIRIFOX 요법 최적화 및 췌장암 2차 치료에서 마이크로바이오타의 역할 탐색: PRODIGE 105-GERCOR 116 PANORAMIX 임상시험
